The '''Videnda sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu's]] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in this sector included [[Dorvalla/Legends|Dorvalla]] and [[Riome]].
